summary: A landmark ruling leaves the owner with development rights that can have value at another address.
realLife: The Supreme Court considered Penn Central’s ability to transfer unused development rights from Grand Central to nearby sites when assessing the burden on the owner.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with landmark, owner, receiving site. A member can ask which other site is eligible before assigning any value to the rights.

turns.what: A receiving lot can take only part of the unused floor area.
turns.pulledBy: The receiving site has less available capacity than the owner seeks to move.
turns.writesBack: The planning record carries a balance of unused rights.
